text: なかなか　なついて　いるのね　その　ちょうしで　かわいがってね

structure.jp: なかなか　なついて　いるのね
structure.en: it's quite attached to you, isn't it

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A て-form on its own at the end is a friendly request, short for てください. かわいがってね = 'treat it lovingly, okay'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: て-form plus いる says the state is still true now. なついて　いる = 'is attached'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells the way something is done. その　ちょうしで = 'in that way, at that pace'.
